message: I'd like a quote for the T75 Row-Crop with Delivery and setup. Any chance of a better price, e.g. $66,000 total?

Thanks for your interest in the T75 Row-Crop! Our pricing is fixed at list, so I'm not able to come down to $66,000. The T75 with delivery and setup comes to $68,900 total: $68,000 for the tractor and $900 for delivery within 150 miles, on-site setup, and a walkthrough. That gets you 75 hp, 4WD, and an enclosed cab with A/C, built for haying, tillage, and heavy implements on 50+ acres. If it helps, I can also quote the front loader or the 3-year extended warranty.
Heartland Tractor Supply posts the T75 at $65,950 and delivery at $875 ($66,825 total). Will you price-match? I'm ready to pay today.

I appreciate that you're ready to move today. Our pricing is fixed at list, though, so I can't price-match. The T75 Row-Crop with delivery and setup stays at $68,900 total. That covers delivery within 150 miles, setup on site, and a walkthrough so you're ready to work right away. If that works for you, the offer below is ready for checkout now.
